name: Expert Stain & Odour Eliminator 3-in-1 for Cats & Ferrets

variants.name: 500 ml
variants.about_this_item: Enzymatic 3-in-1 spray for surfaces, furniture and fabrics soiled by a cat or ferret. Destroys organic soiling — urine, faeces, marking, blood and vomit stains — removes the unpleasant smell and disinfects the treated spot.
variants.ingredient_information: Enzymes dissolve the soiling and remove odours; Nipacide and isopropyl alcohol protect against bacterial and fungal contamination; the "Apelsinia" perfume composition gives a fresh scent.
variants.feeding_instructions: Shake the bottle and spray onto the stain so that the soiled area is well moistened. Use for hygienic treatment and disinfection of household surfaces, furniture and fabrics, of everyday objects and of the places where cats are kept, and of cage surfaces, accessories and ferret housing.
